title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2611.33788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective: To develop and validate InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework for natural language-conditioned generation of synthetic tabular electronic health records (EHRs) and longitudinal trajectories for scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models.   Methods: An optional large language model (LLM) parser converts clinical requests into structured constraints. Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records, while diffusion models generate longitudinal trajectories. We evaluate parsing, distributional fidelity, imputation, clinical-constraint adherence, mortality prediction, and clinical plausibility using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 patients receiving venovenous extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VV-ECMO).   Results: Gemma 3 4B with few-shot prompting achieves the highest parsing performance with a low spurious slot rate. IGE-TabDDPM and IGE-PMVAE perform well in single

translated_title: InterGenEHR$^+$：一个基于自然语言条件的纵向患者轨迹生成交互式框架
translated_abstract: 目的：开发并验证InterGenEHR$^+$，这是一个交互式框架，用于基于自然语言条件生成合成的表格电子健康记录（EHR）和纵向轨迹，以支持机器学习模型的基于场景的评估。方法：一个可选的大语言模型（LLM）解析器将临床请求转换为结构化约束。条件变分自编码器和扩散模型用于生成单时间点记录，而扩散模型用于生成纵向轨迹。我们使用包含874名接受静脉-静脉体外膜肺氧合（VV-ECMO）治疗患者的多机构队列，对解析性能、分布保真度、插补、临床约束依从性、死亡率预测和临床合理性进行了评估。结果：使用少样本提示的Gemma 3 4B实现了最高的解析性能，且虚假槽位率较低。IGE-TabDDPM和IGE-PMVAE在单（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了交互式框架InterGenEHR$^+$，利用大语言模型解析临床需求，并通过生成模型基于自然语言条件合成电子健康记录和纵向患者轨迹，用于机器学习模型的场景化评估。
en_tdlr: Proposes InterGenEHR$^+$, an interactive framework that leverages an LLM parser and generative models to synthesize electronic health records and longitudinal patient trajectories conditioned on natural language, enabling scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models.
